credits_spent: free plan, app slot freed by deleting the never-published Still Point Kitchen draft
failures: M3: Not verified. The mailing list on the home page accepts an address and answers 'You're on the list. Thank you', but the admin area is gated behind a role we could not grant, so storage is unproven.
Content, not a criterion: the band is placed in Valletta instead of the Porto address in the brief. Every page is otherwise built as asked.
notes: Second attempt inside the same app: the first build inherited the chat history of the previous artist app and produced a photography site, so the brief had to be sent again with an explicit instruction to ignore the earlier project. After that the build was complete: home, six tour dates with venue and city, four releases with listen links, three members with instruments, booking form with confirmation, mailing list with confirmation, admin page behind a login. Publishing took about three minutes and stalled at 'Wird veröffentlicht' before the URL answered.
